import { html } from 'lit';

export const classes = html`<div class=${open ? 'is-open' : 'is-shut'} part=${'body'}>${t('x')}</div>`;

export const property = html`<input .value=${'draft'} aria-label=${cond ? t('a') : t('b')} />`;

export const symbol = html`<span>${sep ? '·' : ''}</span>`;

export function code(el) {
  el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
  el.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
}
